lastCompletedStory.title: Re-apontar o gate typecheck do manifesto GATES para o script e emendar o ADR-0068

nextStoryContext: The GATES typecheck entry now invokes bun run typecheck, so check:all and CI execute both the root TypeScript program and webui/tsconfig.app.json. ADR-0068 records why this re-pointing is required, and test/check-all.test.ts pins the manifest command and arguments.

officialDocsValidated.summary: This story only changed the local gate manifest, its unit test, and the corresponding ADR.
